title: Police Move 864 Migrants From Loma Colmenar Streets to New Los Rosales Shelter
detail: Spanish police transferred 864 migrants who had been sleeping outdoors in the Loma Colmenar area to a newly conditioned temporary facility of tents next to the former Los Rosales prison, on SEPES-owned land transferred by the Housing Ministry. Migration Minister Elma Saiz coordinated the operation, which the Ministry of Inclusion, Social Security and Migration called 'a humanitarian operation' carried out with migrants' voluntary agreement. The government also plans a separate facility near the Sidi Embarek Mosque for 300+ women with children, bringing Ceuta's temporary accommodation capacity to roughly 4,300 places, with a target of over 6,000 in the coming days.

media.caption: 864 migrants relocated from Loma Colmenar to the new Los Rosales shelter

title: Spain Says 5,321 Migrants Voluntarily Returned to Morocco Since Aug 10
detail: Territorial Policy Minister Ángel Víctor Torres said 5,321 migrants have voluntarily returned to Morocco since Aug 10 under the government's return program, with roughly 90 people abandoning international protection requests and nearly 1,000 more being registered to complete return proceedings. Ceuta president Juan Jesús Vivas disputed the government's overall numbers, maintaining around 13,000 migrants remain in the city in irregular status or in reception facilities — well above the government's lower estimates.

media.caption: Spain says over 5,300 migrants left Ceuta in a month
